title: DJ-set
excerpt: DJ-deck module based on Cassette 1.0 to play DJ-sets with Orac 2.0 (Organelle) by loading...
content:
DJ-deck module based on Cassette 1.0 to play DJ-sets with Orac 2.0 (Organelle) by loading tracks (from /media/dj-set) up to 10min long in realtime without audio dropouts, with a parametric analog-style start/stop button (aux + knob1), a cue point (C1 key + knob3 + knob4) to (re)start playing and relocate the playhead +/- smoothly depending the knob1 setting, and precise pitch/sync using the rest of the keys + knob2. 

install the module the way you want, then create the /dj-set folder into /media, place .wav files and select them in the module using the encoder.

takes 202mo of RAM (can be 2 in a rack)

v1.2 : added remaining playing time on the position line, with other minor improvements
